title: Safety Reserve for Maintenance Drugs on Member-Opened Exception Requests (Formulary Benefit)
content:
For a member-opened exception request under the Formulary Benefit, a safety reserve is taken off the member's days left when the drug is a maintenance drug. A maintenance drug here is one on the member's retail network maintenance list under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit. The size of the reserve follows the channel of the member's latest fill of the drug.

| Drug on the retail network's maintenance list | Latest fill of the drug | Reserve taken off the days left |
|---|---|---|
| yes | a Home Delivery Pharmacy order | **3** days |
| yes | a paid retail fill | **1** day |
| no | any | none |

The latest fill is the paid retail fill when its date of service is later than the latest shipped home delivery order's date. Otherwise it is that home delivery order. The reserve is taken off the days left before the days left are compared with the member's wait.

*Hypothetical.* A maintenance drug was last shipped by home delivery and the member has 6 days left. After the 3-day reserve, the days left are 3. Compared with a wait of 3 days they are not fewer, so the request is standard. With 5 days left, the days left after the reserve are 2, which is fewer than 3, so the request is expedited.
